messages:
maya_sales: Quick sync — BigCorp asked if our on-prem air-gapped POC can do node-by-node rolling upgrades with minimal downtime and how we handle registries that rewrite digests. They also want a short rollback playbook and POC hotfix pricing.

ezra_se: TL;DR: operator supports orchestrated rolling updates in air-gapped clusters if images are imported to a local registry or preloaded on nodes. Zero visible downtime requires replicas >=2 for stateful services and care around DB migrations.

camille_eng: Important detail: we support two bundle types: full minibundles (everything) and delta bundles (layer deltas + manifest-mapping.json). Delta bundles are much smaller but depend on stable content digests. If the customer's registry rewrites digests we generate a manifest-mapping during the build so operator can remap references at import. That mapping step adds ~15-45min to the import process depending on registry size.

ops_jo: POC hotfixs: we can offer a "POC rapid-patch" add-on (48h triage + signed delta/minibundle + remote assist). Pricing: flat surcharge per month for the POC term. If preflight finds digest-rewriting we include an option for map-generation (one-time) or fallback to full minibundle.

maya_sales: can we put a 2-line SOW blurb in the reply and a 3-step rollback playbook?

ezra_se: SOW blurb: "Redwood will deliver signed offline bundles and an operator to coordinate node-by-node rolling updates in air-gapped environments. High availability requires replicated services; schema-changing DB migrations should be scheduled and tested in staging. An optional 48-hour POC rapid-patch add-on is available for emergency fixes."

camille_eng: Rollback playbook (3 steps):
1) import previous minibundle to jumpbox: `ctr -n k8s.io images import previous-bundle.tar.gz`
2) annotate or patch workloads to pin to the previous digest and `kubectl rollout restart` for affected statefulsets
3) monitor readiness and if pods fail to come up, uncordon nodes and open Redwood SRE ticket with artifact sha256 and mapping file attached

ops_jo: Add verification snippet for their security questionnaire:
```
# on jumpbox after transfer
sha256sum bundle-2026-11-10.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
cosign verify-blob --signature bundle-2026-11-10.tar.gz.sig bundle-2026-11-10.tar.gz
# import to local registry
ctr -n k8s.io images import bundle-2026-11-10.tar.gz
# optional: run preflight that checks for digest rewriting
redwood-preflight --registry registry.internal.local:5000 --check-manifest-mapping
```

maya_sales: ops caveat to include in email: ask whether their registry preserves upstream digests or performs reanchoring; request a jumpbox with scp/sftp access and at least one staging cluster with identical registry flow for validation.

ezra_se: Technical caveat to flag to customer: online DB migrations that take exclusive locks can cause brief pauses even with rolling upgrades; recommend running migrations as non-blocking or in a maintenance window. We'll help validate in staging.

camille_eng: Note on signatures: we produce detached signatures (Notary v2 / cosign compatible). For POC we can sign with Redwood ephemeral keys; for production customers we support BYO KMS/HSM signing and provide verification tooling.

maya_sales: I'll draft the mail: include SOW blurb, rollback playbook, preflight ask (jumpbox + registry behavior), verification snippet, and POC rapid-patch pricing note. tagging @signing-bot for artifact details.

signing-bot: bundle 2026-11-10 created by @camille_eng (sha256:c0ffee1234...); manifest-mapping.json and detached signature uploaded to secure-store"
